description: Level 2 processed spectral data - centroided imzML after baseline correction, peak picking, mass alignment, and normalization. The paired .ibd binary is an unannotated companion.

BASELINE_CORRECTION_METHOD.description: Baseline correction algorithm applied prior to peak picking.
BASELINE_CORRECTION_METHOD.title: BaselineCorrectionMethodEnum

FILENAME.description: Name of the file. Must end with .imzML

FILE_FORMAT.description: Format of the file; processed (centroided) imzML at Level 2

HTAN_PARENT_ID.description: HTAN Parent ID(s) - Foreign key(s) to parent entity (B for Biospecimen, D for data file). One or more IDs; for aggregated files provide multiple. Each ID must have B or D suffix. Supports HTA200-229 for phase 2.

MASS_ACCURACY_PPM.description: Mean absolute mass error (ppm) measured against calibrant peaks.

MASS_ALIGNMENT_METHOD.description: Algorithm used to align m/z peaks across all pixels (e.g., lock-mass, landmark-based).

MASS_TOLERANCE_PPM.description: Mass tolerance (ppm) applied during peak binning and alignment.

MEDIAN_TIC.description: Median total ion current across all pixels after normalization.

NUM_DETECTED_PEAKS.description: Total number of unique m/z features detected after peak picking across the dataset.

PASSED_QC.description: Whether the file passed processing-stage quality control at Level 2.

PEAK_PICKING_METHOD.description: Peak detection algorithm used (e.g., centroid, continuous wavelet transform).

PEAK_PICKING_SNR_THRESHOLD.description: Signal-to-noise ratio threshold applied during peak picking.

PIXEL_COMPLETION_RATE.description: Fraction (0-100%) of expected raster pixels successfully acquired.

PROTOCOL_LINK.description: URL or DOI of the data processing and analysis protocol for this level. Recommended. Re-specified at each level; not propagated from L1.

SMOOTHING_METHOD.description: Spectral smoothing algorithm applied; NONE if no smoothing.
SMOOTHING_METHOD.title: SmoothingMethodEnum

SOFTWARE_AND_VERSION.description: Name and version of the spectral processing software used at this level (e.g., SCiLS Lab 2024, Cardinal 3.4). Re-specified at each level; not propagated from L1.

TIC_CV.description: Coefficient of variation (%) of the total ion current across pixels; acceptance threshold <30%.

title: MassSpectrometryImagingLevel2
